decisions.reason: Turnaround management is closest to the firm's docking and gate knowledge, has its own page, and lets in-house R&D learn from installed-base feedback, so it remains a core part of the integrated platform.

The connectivity module is an enabling layer for the data-driven apron offering and draws on the firm's integration experience, though its lower visibility makes it a candidate for being folded into other modules later.

Equipment monitoring builds directly on the firm's maintenance and installed-equipment expertise, strengthens the service business, and generates field data the firm can readily absorb to improve the product.
Apron resource management sits close to the established offer and fits the move toward automated, integrated operations, so the firm can interpret customer feedback and refine it effectively.
